---
title: "Dataset"
---

```{r}
#| include: false
library(reticulate)
source("R/dua.R")
source("R/db.R")
eda_check_python()
con <- eda_connect()
tables <- sort(DBI::dbListTables(con))
counts <- data.frame(
  tabulka = tables,
  n = vapply(
    tables,
    function(name) {
      DBI::dbGetQuery(
        con,
        paste("SELECT count(*) AS n FROM", DBI::dbQuoteIdentifier(con, name))
      )$n
    },
    numeric(1)
  )
)
```

## Přehled korpusu

Korpus tvoří `r nrow(counts)` tabulek. Zpráv typu discharge je `r dua_count(counts$n[counts$tabulka == "discharge"])`.

```{r}
knitr::kable(dua_table(counts), col.names = c("Tabulka", "Záznamů"), align = "lr")
```

## Příloha: provenance

```{r}
#| include: false
provenance_module <- reticulate::import("mediparse.entrypoints.eda_provenance")
pathlib <- reticulate::import("pathlib")
details <- provenance_module$provenance(
  as.list(Sys.getenv()),
  pathlib$Path(Sys.getenv("PIXI_PROJECT_ROOT")),
  pathlib$Path(eda_parquet_dir())
)
details[["r"]] <- R.version.string
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(
  data.frame(Položka = names(details), Hodnota = unlist(details, use.names = FALSE)),
  align = "ll"
)
```
